text:
casey: heads-up: spike in WS reconnects this morning on /v1/stream for a few tenants. console marks them as `client_idle` but edge logs show server heartbeat ACKs delayed, then connection closed. looks like it happens right after clients start sending a lot of parallel streams.

lin: can you paste a log sample and tenant ids? is there any config rollout recently?

casey: snippet from edge (prod-east):
```
[2026-03-05T10:10:11Z] conn=t7ef ping_sent
[2026-03-05T10:10:14Z] conn=t7ef ping_ack_delayed=310ms
[2026-03-05T10:10:14Z] conn=t7ef inflight=72 inflight_limit=80 warmup=true
[2026-03-05T10:10:15Z] conn=t7ef close=server:heartbeat_timeout
```
Tenants: tenant-42, tenant-99 (high concurrency workloads). No config rollout noted.

ops-bot: :warning: WS reconnect rate (tenant-42) = 4.2x baseline

sam: similar to the inflight ramp problem we discussed last quarter. default inflight limit was increased for throughput, and our warmup path ramps quickly to the new limit. during ramp the event loop gets saturated and heartbeat callbacks are delayed. console only sees final close and marks client as idle.

lin: console impact: all reconnect SLOs and incident pages will show these as client faults. We should add a warmup tag or a transient connection attribute so dashboards can separate these. Also we should avoid creating new high-cardinality metrics.

yara: short-term mitigations: (A) slow the ramp (e.g. step 8->24->48->80 over 20s) (B) enforce a low per-tenant concurrent-open threshold for first 60s (C) prioritize processing of heartbeat events in the runtime loop.

casey: prefer (A) + (C) as quick flip. can we gate with a runtime flag for canary? want to test on a small subset of edges first.

sam: we can add feature flag runtime.ws_ramp_slow=true and emit two low-cardinality metrics: `ws.inflight_peak_warmup` and `ws.heartbeat_ack_95p_sampled` (1% sampling) with tags: region, route, warmup=true. that should let console plot warmup vs non-warmup without exploding cardinality.

lin: PR request: add dashboard panel 'Warmup: reconnects vs normal' and modify the reconnect alert to ignore spikes where >80% of disconnects have warmup=true OR spike resolves in <90s. we should also annotate the alert with the canary flag.

ops-bot: Deploy plan created: PR 4120 by @lin - feature flag runtime.ws_ramp_slow=true on canary edges (5%).

yara: rolling canary to 5% now (start ts=1748610005). monitoring reconnect rate, inflight_peak_warmup, heartbeat_ack_95p_sampled for 15m.

casey: early canary metrics look promising: reconnects down ~55% on canary edges. heartbeat ack 95p dropped from ~420ms -> ~110ms.

sam: tail still visible for tenants that open thousands of sessions almost simultaneously. long term we probably need tenant-aware admission control (either a soft cap or token-bucket for opening concurrency). I'll draft an RFC.

lin: I'll land the dashboard changes once metrics are emitted. Ops will update runbook to include warmup-filtered reconnect troubleshooting steps.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary complete at 1748610285 - metrics stable, promote to 100% in staged rollout.

casey: thanks all. follow-ups: sam -> RFC for tenant admission, lin -> dashboard and alert tweak, yara -> perf PR to prioritize heartbeats. leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
